narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four plus six plus two is twelve, not eleven, so it is not divisible by eleven.
<bookmark mark='short'/>Adding the digits works for nine, but sixty is six short for eleven, not six extra.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The shortfall must be taken away, not added.
